checks_run.procedure: D-041 direct source review: the diff 6db3b83..2386a0f of rules.mjs and validator.test.mjs, and the full checkClosure, checkInvocation, commitPresent and findManifest code. Check that all three anchors are enforced independently, that the commitPresent() header describes the three-anchor model, that findManifest's content-preserving tolerance is the single absence tolerance, and that review_rounds.source_commit is schema-pinned to 40-hex (so no symbolic ref can feed anchor 1).
checks_run.command: git diff 6db3b83..2386a0f -- tools/gates/lib/rules.mjs tools/gates/tests/validator.test.mjs docs/delivery/decisions.md; sed -n 360,460p;590,780p;860,960p tools/gates/lib/rules.mjs; grep source_commit tools/gates/schemas/stages.schema.json
checks_run.expected: three anchors each enforced; comment accurate; no new tolerance
checks_run.actual: The anchors are at :742-743 (round.source_commit, conditional on commitPresent), :744-746 (run head) and :747-748 (gate candidate), each pushing its own error. The commitPresent header (:597-605) describes the three-anchor model. The only absence tolerance is still findManifest's (:910-926), reached after the entries hash to candidate_id (:900-904). review_rounds[].source_commit is ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ in stages.schema.json. One inaccuracy: anchor 1 is skipped when the round's source_commit is absent, so the claims at :603-605 and :737-738 ('always rejected, whatever the round metadata says') are too strong. I recorded this as F-DG0-169 (Low), reproduced in SEC25-C04.

summary: PASS with one Low observation. D-041 closes F-DG0-168: checkClosure now enforces all three anchors, and on --no-local clones the genuine post-freeze, pre-run fix is rejected by anchor 1 while the round-23 forge is still rejected by anchor 2. No regression: all 114 real closures pass all three anchors, and there are 101/101 node tests, 22/22 Python tests and an 11/11 pre-freeze. New F-DG0-169 (Low, not mandatory): anchor 1 is skipped when a round self-declares an absent source_commit, so that forge combined with a post-freeze, pre-run fix still passes, and the new comment and D-041 overstate the guarantee. This is within threat-model residual 1, and no real closure depends on it.
